items.title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
items.why: Agentic checkout could reshape how card benefits and offers get triggered, so test whether premium perks can attach to agent-initiated purchases.
items.summary_ai: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are exploring AI agents that complete financial transactions without human involvement.
